title: 046. Maximum Depth Of Binary Tree
prompt: Given `root` of a binary tree, return its maximum depth (number of nodes along the longest root-to-leaf path).
firstLine: Base case `if not root: return 0`, else return `1 + max(...)`.
pythonOutlineComments:
# Step 1: If `not root`, return `0`
# Step 2: Recursively compute `left_d = self.maxDepth(root.left)` and `right_d = self.maxDepth(root.right)`
# Step 3: Return `1 + max(left_d, right_d)`

hints.title: First-Line Nudge
hints.content: Base case `if not root: return 0`, else return `1 + max(...)`.

hints.title: Step-by-Step Plan
hints.content: Step 1: If `not root`, return `0` -> Step 2: Recursively compute `left_d = self.maxDepth(root.left)` and `right_d = self.maxDepth(root.right)` -> Step 3: Return `1 + max(left_d, right_d)`

hints.title: Complexity & Edge Cases
hints.content: Aim for O(N) time and O(H) space. Watch empty inputs, single elements, and duplicates.
